zh-CN.title: 发言可编辑更多内容
items: 在熟悉的发表界面修改正文、图片、视频、语音、外部分享、位置和可见范围。
保存后保留原发布时间和互动。点击「已编辑」可查看历史版本及改动项目。

en.title: Edit more of your Square posts
items: Use the familiar composer to edit text, photos, video, voice, shared links, location and audience.
Edits keep the original post time and interactions. Select Edited to see previous versions and what changed.
